answer: Fight sybil volume with a bottleneck it cannot script: scarce proctored certification. Like an ocean that admits only as many ships as its harbor pilots can guide, certified identities are capped at proctor capacity — slots go by verifiable lottery, each earned in a live, unscripted examination from fresh material, impossible to pre-answer across a puppet fleet. A willow has one trunk; one operator cannot sit in a thousand exam rooms at once. Each badge expires after N epochs, so the cost is per-identity and perpetual, and farming at scale collapses under its umber scheduling weight.
